reference_boundary: OpenAI source docs are citation metadata and governance references only. This manifest promotes platform-neutral ADK improvement-loop contracts and must not enable hosted services, external runtimes, user-directory writes, or compatibility defaults.

promotion_gate: representative traces cover at least one pass and one failure
eval candidate fails before the fix and passes after the fix when feasible
developer approves the diff before merge or apply
must_not: open, merge or deploy pull requests automatically by default
promote model feedback without human or deterministic validation
treat one traced run as a recurring failure pattern

promotion_gate: baseline exists before candidate change is promoted
representative eval data includes pass and fail or boundary cases
change rationale cites which ladder step was used
higher-cost or higher-risk steps require owner approval
fine-tuning is blocked unless a separate training-data and leakage review exists
must_not: start with fine-tuning when prompt/context/tool improvements are untested
promote prompt changes without eval evidence
reuse eval datasets as training data without leakage review
optimize only for cost without quality and latency checks
